full_judgment:
3. The appellants herein as the plaintiffs filed Title Suit No.160 of 1994 in the Third Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Dhaka for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession of the suit land described in schedule to the plaint against the respondents herein. 

 15. Admittedly, the plaintiff-appellants filed the suit for declaration of title and recovery of khash possession in respect of the suit land appended to the plaint. Admittedly, the suit land belonged to Sabjan Bibi. The plaintiffs' claim is that Sabjan Bibi sold the suit land to Lal Mohammad and after his death the suit land was owned and possessed by his 5 sons and the plaintiffs are successive purchasers of the suit land from 2 sons of Lal Mohammad, namely, Kamaruddin and Samad Ali. On the other hand, the defendants' claim is that Sabjan Bibi did not sell the land to Lal Mohammad and that she sold the suit land to Dhanu Miah, a son of Lal Mohammad, by a registered deed of sale dated 16.11.1916.
